arms.N: shipped: the aligner on node similarity alone (placement off)
arms.P: deployed placement matcher (placement on), E on the STEP-2 scale

freshness.rule: any nonzero count refuses the read

frozen.e_reading: PLACEMENT_E_NORMALISED (mean over judged slots, refused below the minimum)
frozen.frame_provider: the shipped field provider. If the Step-2 FIT decision adopts the keypoint provider, this field is AMENDED, with a dated note, before the first read graph exists -- the read photos are untouched by the validation

gallery.correspondence: the exact transform, applied to the node anchors
gallery.rule: the photo's own original image; one candidate per query

mde.note: the realized bank size is reported with the read and the realized MDE replaces this planning number, never the verdict

mission: 12 step 5 -- real-photo correspondence under exact known transforms

no_harm.rule: the lower end of the photo-clustered interval for P - N must not fall below -0.02

photos.note: the six validation photos are NEVER used in this read; they are what the frame validation is allowed to build

primary.bank: near-tie nodes (frozen rule) that the transform maps into the image
primary.contrast: P - N on correspondence accuracy (the mapped node is the transformed true counterpart)

verdict_rule: DETECTED iff the photo-clustered interval excludes zero in the pre-registered direction (P > N); a detected effect below the realized MDE is labelled possibly inflated
